text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Yukino Bijin gets injured during training, so I bring her to the infirmary.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Sorry 'bout this. I should've been more careful…

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: An inj'ry like this is noth'n to worry about, though! C'mon, let's go train some more!
choice_data_list: No, you should rest and take care of yourself.
Okay… as long as you don't push yourself too hard.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: But… if I only run a li'l bit, I'll prob'ly be just fine!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Well, I trust your advice, Trainer… so I'll do what you think's best.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: But once I'm all better, I hope you'll let me train extra t'make up for t'day…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Deflated, Yukino Bijin heads back to her dorm.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Okay, let's get right to it!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Maybe I took this inj'ry a little too lightly… I guess I should've rested up, huh…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As I lend Yukino Bijin my shoulder to lean on, I tell her that sometimes willpower alone just isn't enough.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I wasn't sure how this'd go, but… I guess things work out if you've got the gumption!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: All righty—I think I can manage another lap!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Taking care not to push herself too hard, Yukino Bijin continues her training session.
